name: PhD Programs in Biomedical Sciences
detailsNote: The official page gives the application deadline as December 1 without a year, so it is shown as a published date and not confirmed for Fall 2027. The accepted English tests and minimum scores are on a separate page that was not read.
summary: A common first-year PhD entry route at the University at Buffalo. Students explore research areas and laboratories before choosing a faculty advisor and a participating program.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline (year not stated)
publishedDeadlines.note: The How to Apply page says the application and all supporting documents must be received by December 1 and that no extensions are granted. No year is given, so confirm Fall 2027 on the official page.

timeline.interviews: Strong applicants will be invited to interview.

english.note: International applicants must present a valid English language proficiency test score. Test dates must be no older than two years when students enter the program. The accepted tests and minimum scores are on a separate university page that was not read; check it.

applicationFee.note: Fee waivers are given only to participants in listed programs (for example AmeriCorps, McNair Scholars, EOP/HEOP/SEEK, veteran or military status, a GRE fee waiver, Project 1000). The page says it cannot grant fee waivers for any other reasons, including for international applicants.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from every college or university attended
Personal statement with three parts (500, 500 and 750 words)
requirements.note: Official transcripts are required only if admitted.

funding.note: The page says all accepted students receive a full-tuition scholarship and stipend, with medical and dental insurance. It gives a $35,000 stipend but no year or length of support.
